LITERATURE IN ENGLISH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: LITERATURE IN ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. One main idea with supporting sentences
   B. Only one word repeated
   C. Many unrelated topics with no link
   D. No full stops

2. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only an action
   B. Only a joining word
   C. Only a describing word
   D. A person, place, thing, or idea

3. When practising Poetry 1.2.1 Appreciating Poetry Elements of poetry - Persona - Subject matter -, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Poetry 1.2.1 Appreciating Poetry Elements of poetry - Persona - Subject matter -.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Poetry 1.2.1 Appreciating Poetry Elements of poetry - Persona - Subject matter -.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Poetry 1.2.1 Appreciating Poetry Elements of poetry - Persona - Subject matter -.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Poetry 1.2.1 Appreciating Poetry Elements of poetry - Persona - Subject matter -.

   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Fiction and Non- Fiction 2.3.1 Fiction: The Novel Novel from Africa and novel fr.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Fiction and Non- Fiction 2.3.1 Fiction: The Novel Novel from Africa and novel fr.

7. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. quickly
   B. blue
   C. happiness
   D. run

8. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. where is the library
   B. Where is the Library
   C. Where is the library?
   D. Where is the library

9. When practising Fiction: The Novel Novel from Africa and novel from the rest of the world - Them, which approach is best? (1 mark)
